id: 186_调压器、常用器件与电工工具
title: 调压器、常用器件与电工工具
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/186_调压器、常用器件与电工工具.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/186_调压器、常用器件与电工工具/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在断电的实验台前，身边摆着调压器、变阻器和一排工具
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a powered off electrical training bench with a round knob variable transformer, a sliding rheostat and a row of hand tools, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十四课：调压器、器件与工具。
overlay: 调压器、常用器件与电工工具

shots.scene: 阿杰把调压器旋钮拧到零，伸手去碰输出接线柱
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns a variable transformer knob to the lowest position and reaches a bare hand toward its output terminals, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：调到零了，碰一下没事吧？

shots.scene: 王老师拦住，指着没断开的总开关
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops his hand and points at the bench main switch which is still on, the indicator lamp lit.
shots.narration: 王老师：调到零，电路照样带电！

shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a tool box and a variable transformer manual, nodding.
shots.narration: 小研：器件和工具，先认清再用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a resistor, a capacitor, an inductor coil and a bundle of wires on a table. No text.
shots.narration: 先认识电阻、电容、电感和导线。

shots.scene: 仪表、仪器、变压器和电机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of meters, a direct current power supply, an oscilloscope with a blank screen, a transformer and an electric motor. No text.
shots.narration: 还有仪表、稳压电源、示波器和电机。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metal bar with many small free electron dots moving inside, beside a plastic bar with almost none. No text.
shots.narration: 导体里自由电子多，容易导电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three groups, a copper wire for carrying power, a glowing heating coil, and plastic and glass for insulation. No text.
shots.narration: 铜铝输电，电阻丝发热，塑料玻璃绝缘。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a resistance symbol flipped into its reciprocal, a large resistance arrow pointing to small conductance. No text.
shots.narration: 电导是电阻的倒数，单位西门子。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a copper wire with a high conductivity icon and a soldering icon, a small weight and coin icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 铜线导电好、好焊接，就是重些贵些。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an aluminum wire on a balance lighter than copper, a conductivity bar at about sixty percent. No text.
shots.narration: 铝线轻又便宜，导电约为铜的六成。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a galvanized iron wire on an overhead line pole and an earthing rod, a low conductivity bar. No text.
shots.narration: 镀锌铁线重、导电差，多用于架空和接地。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long thin wire with a large resistance bar beside a short thick wire with a small resistance bar. No text.
shots.narration: 导线越长电阻越大，越粗电阻越小。

shots.scene: R等于电阻率乘长度除以截面
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire segment with length and cross section area highlighted and a material icon. No text.
shots.narration: 电阻等于电阻率乘长度，除以截面积。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large current arrow through a thick wire checked, the same current through a thin hot wire crossed out, a rating chart icon. No text.
shots.narration: 电流大选粗线，按回路电流和规定选。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an overloaded thin wire glowing with heat and smoke, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 线细电流大，会发热甚至起火。

shots.scene: 导体加绝缘层，电只走芯线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cross section of a wire with a copper core inside a plastic sheath, a current arrow kept inside the core and a hand safely holding the sheath. No text.
shots.narration: 导体加绝缘层，电只走芯线，保护人。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plastic sheath and a vulcanized rubber sheath checked, a raw natural rubber strip crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘常用塑料、硫化橡胶。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wire with cracked insulation and exposed copper strands, crossed out, a replacement wire checked. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘破了、露铜了，换掉不用。

shots.scene: 【实拍】实心线、绞合线、多股软线样品
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of short samples of a solid core wire, a stranded wire and a fine flexible multi strand wire laid side by side on a bench.
shots.narration: 实心线一根芯；多股线丝细，更柔软。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single core cable and a twin core cable in cross section. No text.
shots.narration: 还有单芯、双芯，按电路选用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring shaped core with a single winding and a sliding contact brush on top. No text.
shots.narration: 自耦调压器只有一个绕组。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a round knob turning and an output voltage bar rising smoothly. No text.
shots.narration: 转动旋钮，交流电压平滑可调。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a variable transformer box with a round knob and a voltage scale ring, a nameplate left blank. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室常简称调压器，用来调节电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: input and output sharing one winding, an electrical path drawn straight from the mains to the output. No text.
shots.narration: 同一绕组，省铜经济，但不隔离电网。

shots.scene: 输出调低也可能带电网电位
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an output terminal at a low voltage setting still connected to the mains, an electric shock warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 输出调得再低，对地也可能是电网电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a variable transformer with an isolation transformer icon beside it, an equal sign crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 它不是隔离变压器，也不是安全电源。

shots.scene: 输入接电源，输出随旋钮变
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single phase variable transformer with input terminals for line and neutral and output terminals, wired on a powered off bench. No text.
shots.narration: 输入接相线和中性线，输出随旋钮变。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single phase variable transformer and a larger three phase variable transformer with three windings. No text.
shots.narration: 有单相和三相，三相实验用三相的。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a finger pointing at the blank nameplate of a variable transformer on a powered off bench.
shots.narration: 用前先看铭牌，电压电流不超额定。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning the knob of a variable transformer fully back to the zero position, the bench switched off.
shots.narration: 通电前，旋钮先回到零位。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter needle rising slowly as the knob turns, a stop line at the target value. No text.
shots.narration: 看着电压表慢慢升，电流不超额定。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob returned to zero first, then the main switch turned off, numbered order. No text.
shots.narration: 用完先回零，再断开电源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a knob at zero with a live supply still connected, a hand touching terminals crossed out, a main switch off icon checked. No text.
shots.narration: 调到零不等于断电，动线先断开关。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sliding rheostat with a ceramic tube wound with resistance wire and a slider on a top rod. No text.
shots.narration: 变阻器，就是阻值可调的电阻。

shots.scene: 两个固定端，一个滑动端
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the rheostat with its two fixed end terminals and one slider terminal highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 两头是固定端，滑块是滑动端，共三个。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two circuit symbols of a variable resistor, one with an arrow across and one with an arrow tap. No text.
shots.narration: 画图用这两种符号，箭头端可变。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one fixed terminal and the slider terminal wired into a circuit, the active length of wire highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 任取一个固定端和滑动端接入。

shots.scene: 接入越长越大：全长最大，一小段最小
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the slider moving along the tube, the full length in circuit marked maximum and a short length marked minimum, a resistance bar. No text.
shots.narration: 接入越长电阻越大，全长最大一段最小。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电时把滑块推到电阻最大端
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand pushing the insulated knob of a rheostat slider to the maximum resistance end on a powered off bench.
shots.narration: 作限流用，通电前滑块放在最大。

shots.scene: 看铭牌：阻值和额定电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rheostat nameplate with a resistance icon and a rated current icon, both highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 铭牌标阻值和额定电流，同样重要。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ammeter in series with the rheostat, the slider moving slowly and the needle staying below the limit. No text.
shots.narration: 通电后看着电流表，慢慢调小。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rheostat with heat waves rising from its tube, a hot surface warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 电流大时，变阻器会发烫。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the bare resistance wire of a rheostat with an electric shock warning sign, a finger touching it crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 电阻丝裸露带电，通电时不能碰。

shots.scene: 只握绝缘手柄，远离易燃物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand holding only the insulated slider knob, paper sheets near the rheostat crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 调节只握绝缘手柄，旁边不放纸张。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a knife switch with its blades counted as poles and its contact positions counted as throws. No text.
shots.narration: 开关看两样：几个极，几个掷。

shots.scene: 【实拍】数一数刀开关的刀片和触点
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a finger counting the blades and contact positions of a disconnected open knife switch on a training board.
shots.narration: 数一数刀片和触点，就分清了。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single pole single throw switch opening and closing a lamp circuit. No text.
shots.narration: 单极单掷：一个刀，只管通和断。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single pole double throw switch with its blade moving between two contacts, only one connected at a time. No text.
shots.narration: 单极双掷：两个位置，一次只接一个。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two single pole double throw switches at each end of a staircase controlling one lamp. No text.
shots.narration: 两地控制照明，就靠单极双掷。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a double pole single throw switch with two blades moving together. No text.
shots.narration: 双极单掷：两个刀一起动作。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one blade on the line conductor and one on the neutral conductor, both opened together. No text.
shots.narration: 一刀接相线、一刀接零线，同时断开。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a double pole double throw switch with normally open and normally closed contacts highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 双极双掷有常开、常闭，用于复杂电路。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a triple pole single throw switch connecting three phase supply lines to a three phase load together. No text.
shots.narration: 三极单掷：三相同时接通、同时断开。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a triple pole double throw switch moving three phase lines between two positions, a teacher icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 三极双掷做三相切换，在老师指导下用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single pole switch placed on the line conductor of a lamp circuit checked, placed on the neutral crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 单极开关接相线，断开后灯不带电。

shots.scene: 开关前面的线照样有电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an opened switch with the supply side wires still glowing as live and the load side dark. No text.
shots.narration: 开关断开，电源侧照样有电，刀闸别碰。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an upstream breaker locked off with a padlock and a tag, an electrician icon working. No text.
shots.narration: 检修断上级电源挂牌，由电工处理。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a switch rating icon matched to the circuit voltage and current, a mismatched small switch crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 开关额定电压电流，要和电路相配。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fuse in a circuit melting under an overcurrent and stopping the current, protecting a load. No text.
shots.narration: 熔断器防过电流，保护线路和设备。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fuse placed in series on the line conductor checked, a fuse on the neutral crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 熔断器串联在相线上，不接零线。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: fuses of several ratings, the one matched to the load rated current checked. No text.
shots.narration: 按负载的额定电流选规格。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blown fuse, the power switched off, a teacher checking for a short circuit, a copper wire replacing a fuse crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 熔断了先断电查原因，不用铜丝代替。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a screwdriver style voltage tester with a small neon lamp glowing in its handle. No text.
shots.narration: 试电笔查有没有电，氖泡亮说明带电。

shots.scene: 内部电阻、氖泡、弹簧，电流经人体入地
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cutaway voltage tester with a metal tip, a large resistor, a neon lamp and a spring, a tiny current path through the hand and body capacitance to the ground. No text.
shots.narration: 电流经大电阻、氖泡、人体入地，极小。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several kinds of voltage testers, a pen type, a screwdriver type and a non contact type. No text.
shots.narration: 试电笔品种多，只用于规定的低压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage tester checked first on a known live socket by a teacher icon, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 用前先在确认有电处试，证明笔是好的。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dark neon lamp on a wire that is still live, a question mark, a broken tester icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 不亮不一定没电，笔坏了也不亮。

shots.scene: 确认无电用检验合格的仪表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tested multimeter verified on a known source, then used to confirm zero voltage on a powered off circuit. No text.
shots.narration: 确认无电，要用检验合格的仪表测。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand holding a voltage tester with a finger on the metal end cap and away from the metal tip, not touching any circuit.
shots.narration: 手只按尾部，不碰笔尖，不当起子拧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a screwdriver blade fitted into a screw head and the handle turning. No text.
shots.narration: 螺丝刀拧紧、松开螺钉。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a matching blade fully seated in a screw slot checked, a too small blade slipping crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 刀头卡紧螺钉，大小要匹配。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a screwdriver tightening a terminal screw on a powered off wiring board. No text.
shots.narration: 装接线板、接开关，都离不开它。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: long nose pliers gripping a small part, bending a wire loop and cutting a thin wire. No text.
shots.narration: 尖嘴钳能夹、能弯、能剪。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: diagonal cutting pliers snipping a copper wire and a thin iron wire. No text.
shots.narration: 斜口钳专门剪线，铜线铁丝都能剪。

shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a wire stripper removing insulation from the end of a loose disconnected wire, the copper strands intact.
shots.narration: 剥绝缘皮，最好用剥线钳。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: pliers biting into a wire and nicking the copper strands, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用钳子硬剥，容易伤到铜芯。

shots.scene: 【实拍】压线钳把端子压在线头上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a crimping tool pressing a terminal lug onto a stripped loose wire end on a bench.
shots.narration: 压线钳把端子压紧在导线上。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a firm crimped joint checked, a loose joint with heat waves crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 压接牢固，接头才不松不发热。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a power off switch before a wire is cut, a live wire being cut crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 剥线、剪线之前，先断电。

shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears safety glasses and cuts a loose wire with the end pointing down into a tray.
shots.narration: 戴护目镜，线头朝下，防止弹飞。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: wire offcuts collected into a small box, offcuts scattered near terminals crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 剪下的线头，随手收好。

shots.scene: 【实拍】用前检查螺丝刀和钳子的绝缘柄
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands turning a screwdriver and a pair of pliers to inspect their insulated handles for cracks.
shots.narration: 用前查绝缘柄，有裂纹破损就停用。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an insulated screwdriver near a live terminal crossed out, a power off switch checked. No text.
shots.narration: 绝缘柄不能代替断电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hand tools returned to their outlined places on a tool board. No text.
shots.narration: 工具用完清点归位，不留在台面上。

shots.scene: 稳压电源：开关和指示灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a direct current regulated power supply front panel with a power switch, an indicator lamp and two identical output channels, blank displays. No text.
shots.narration: 稳压电源：开关、指示灯、两个通道。

shots.scene: 【实拍】关机状态下认红黑输出端
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a finger pointing at the red and black output terminals of a switched off regulated power supply.
shots.narration: 红色是正极，黑色是负极，不能接反。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the rear nameplate of the power supply with an output range icon, a direct current circuit board beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 看铭牌输出范围，直流实验用它供电。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a coarse knob and a fine knob turning, the blank display switching between voltage and current icons. No text.
shots.narration: 粗调细调配合，设定输出电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a current limit knob set to a marked value, a knob turned fully to maximum crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 限流按实验要求设，不是越大越好。

shots.scene: 空载调好，断电接负载，输出不短路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: voltage set with no load, the output switched off, then the load connected, output terminals touched together with a spark crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 空载调好再断开接负载，输出不能短路。

shots.scene: 调压器回零缓升，不隔离
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a variable transformer knob at zero with an upward arrow and a broken isolation shield icon. No text.
shots.narration: 调压器：回零缓升，它不隔离电网。

shots.scene: 变阻器放最大，开关断相线，熔断器串相线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rheostat slider at maximum, a switch and a fuse on the line conductor, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 变阻器先放最大，开关熔断器接相线。

shots.scene: 试电笔先验证，工具查绝缘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltage tester checked on a known source and an insulated tool inspected, a power off icon. No text.
shots.narration: 试电笔先验证；工具查绝缘、断电用。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两个开关和一盏灯之间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between two wall switches at the bottom and top of a staircase with one lamp lit above, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：照明控制与开路短路。
